scope: Independent read-only review of seven candidate adapters, reporting installer and direct lifecycle/identity/readonly seams; targeted re-review of repairs.

findings.problem: Blank lines before TOML hook headers were consumed by the header regexp, so status missed installed hooks and repeated install/uninstall was incorrect.
findings.repair: Limit header whitespace to spaces/tabs and derive ranges from the actual header bracket.
findings.regression: Blank-line and indented hook tables, idempotent installation, exact own-entry removal preserving user content.

findings.problem: A # inside the quoted reporting command path was interpreted as a TOML comment.
findings.repair: Match the whole quoted JSON string or unquoted primitive followed only by whitespace and an optional comment; malformed fields refuse installation/uninstallation without changing the original file.
findings.regression: # in XDG data path, inline comments, escaped quoted strings and non-comment trailing tokens; malformed install/uninstall preserves bytes with zero writes and releases the lock.

findings.problem: Unknown or damaged retained records were silently skipped while inspectTranscript issued complete coverage.
findings.repair: Validate every expanded record and known payload shape; reject unrecognized records and bound the expanded count.

findings.problem: Only the first workspace declaration was retained, so conflicting metadata/route facts could pass identity and resume admission.
findings.repair: Normalize and verify every absolute workspace declaration in the shared parser used by identity, resume and coverage.

limits: No live installer, model or Orca actions were performed by review or repair agents.
Muse native compatibility remains unverified; it is not registered.
Kimi hook parsing supports the installer-generated JSON values, not arbitrary hand-edited TOML literal syntax.
Mixed Controller remains blocked on public exact-terminal readiness and has not been counted as PASS.
This audit is not the schema-required final verification artifact.
